metadata.title: That one kill where I definitely wasn’t trying... but hey, it worked in VALORANT!
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just get that kill by accident?
Watch me act like a pro when it’s pure chaos.
Only VALORANT logic could pull this off.
Click if luck ever saved your no-skill moment!

Hit play if your luck is better than your aim!
